cohort: Patients admitted to the departments of surgery, gynecology/obstetrics and internal medicine at the Albert Schweitzer Hospital in Lambaréné, Gabon.
finding: The cumulative incidence of nosocomial infections was low (1.6%), but high rates of surgical site infections and multi-resistant pathogens were observed.
mod_finding: High rates of nosocomial infections were found after hysterectomies (12%) and Caesarean sections (6%).
